  }}
 
function notshowsetCookie() {
    var messaging_cookies = document.cookie.split(';').map(cookie => cookie.split('=')).reduce((accumulator, [key, value]) => ({ ...accumulator, [key.trim()]: decodeURIComponent(value) }), {});

        document.getElementsByClassName("amp-messaging-strip-wrapper")[0].style.display = "none";

}

var messaging_cookies_onload = document.cookie.split(';').map(cookie => cookie.split('=')).reduce((accumulator, [key, value]) => ({ ...accumulator, [key.trim()]: decodeURIComponent(value) }), {});
 
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function (e) {
    
    let element = document.getElementById("message-closed");

<script>
var footermobilewidth;
 
function footergetWindow() {
  footermobilewidth = 768;
  var windowSize = $(window).width();
  if (windowSize < footermobilewidth) {
    $('.footer-list').addClass('accordion');
    footerinitFooterAccordion();
  } else {
    $('.footer-list').removeClass('accordion');
  }
}
 
function footerinitFooterAccordion() {
  var target = $('.menu-links.primary div');
  target.each(function() {
    var clickTarget = $(this).find('h5');
    clickTarget.off('click'); // Remove existing event handlers to prevent multiple bindings
    clickTarget.on('click', function(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopImmediatePropagation();
      $(this).toggleClass('show');
      $(this).next().toggleClass('show');
    });
  });
}
 
function footerpopModal() {
  var FooterModal = $('#open-modal');
  var Footerbutton = $('#subscribe_button');
  var CloseButton = $('.modal-close');
  var ampFooterBody = $('body'); // Cache the body element for better performance
 
  if (Footerbutton.length && FooterModal.length) {
    Footerbutton.off('click'); // Remove existing event handlers to prevent multiple bindings
    CloseButton.off('click'); // Remove existing event handlers to prevent multiple bindings
 
    Footerbutton.on('click', function(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      FooterModal.addClass('show');
      FooterModal.css('display', 'block');
      ampFooterBody.addClass('modal-open'); // Add overlay class to body
      ampFooterBody.css('padding-right', '22px'); // Add padding-right
      var Footerval = FooterModal.find('iframe').data('src');
      FooterModal.find('iframe').attr('src', Footerval);
    });
 
    CloseButton.on('click', function(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      FooterModal.removeClass('show');
      FooterModal.css('display', 'none');
      ampFooterBody.removeClass('modal-open'); // Remove overlay class from body
      ampFooterBody.css('padding-right', ''); // Remove padding-right
    });
  }
}
 
function footerURLID() {
  var FooterLinks = document.getElementsByClassName("footertag");
  for (var i = 0; i < FooterLinks.length; i++) {
    var FooterLinkID = FooterLinks[i].id;
    if (FooterLinkID) {
      let FooterText = document.getElementById(FooterLinkID);
      let FooterAddURL = FooterText.href;
      FooterText.href = FooterAddURL + "#" + FooterLinkID;
    }
  }
}
 
window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  $(document).ready(function() {
    $(window).resize(function() {
      footergetWindow();
    });
    footergetWindow();
    footerpopModal();
    footerURLID();
  });
});

</script>

const stringToUuidV4 = (str) => {
  // Remove non-hex characters
  str = str.replace(/[^a-fA-F0-9]/g, '');

  // Repeat and slice to ensure 32 hex characters
  while (str.length < 32) {
    str += str;
  }
  str = str.slice(0, 32);

  // Force version 4 (13th character)
  str = str.substring(0, 12) + '4' + str.substring(13);

  // Force variant (17th character)
  const variantChar = parseInt(str[16], 16);
  const forcedVariant = (variantChar & 0x3) | 0x8;
  str = str.substring(0, 16) + forcedVariant.toString(16) + str.substring(17);

  // Format as UUID
  return `${str.substring(0, 8)}-${str.substring(8, 12)}-${str.substring(12, 16)}-${str.substring(16, 20)}-${str.substring(20)}`;
};

var reduceArrayFunction = function(arrayToReduce){
  var toReduce = arrayToReduce.reduce(function(toReduceCount, currentItem){
    if(typeof toReduceCount[currentItem] !== "undefined"){
      toReduceCount[currentItem]++; 
      return toReduceCount;
    } else {
      toReduceCount[currentItem]=1; 
      return toReduceCount;
    }
  }, {});

  //reduce duplicate values and count
  var toReduceArray = [];
  for(var x in toReduce){
    var object = {"name": x, "number": toReduce[x]}
    toReduceArray.push(object);
  }

  //sort by count - high to low so highest count is always top
  function compare( a, b ) {
    if ( a.number < b.number ){
      return 1;
    }
    if ( a.number > b.number ){
      return -1;
    }
    return 0;
  }
  return toReduceArray.sort(compare);
}

                    const today = new Date().setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);

                    const timeDiff = Math.abs(deliveryDateSelected - today);

                  })[0] /
                  (1000 * 3600 * 24)
               )|| "";

      }
          else return '';
        }
      else return "bundle";

   return '';
  }

}

function uniq(a) { //function to sort through an array, order it, and dedupe it
  return a.sort().filter(function (item, pos, ary) {
      return !pos || item != ary[pos - 1];
  });
}

function removeDuplicates(arr) {

}

    interval = interval || 500;
